description:
apple.go lines 190-194 use strings.Contains to match error messages like 'not found', 'No such container', 'does not exist'. These will break silently if Apple CLI changes wording.

Options:
- Parse exit codes instead of error text
- Use structured JSON output where available
- At minimum, add tests that verify error matching against real CLI output
title: Apple runtime: replace fragile string-based error matching
